assertion: Exemptions from routine vaccines among U.S. kindergartners increased to a record high 4.2% during the 2025-26 school year
sql: SELECT school_year, coverage_estimate FROM health.cdc_school_vaccination_coverage WHERE geography='United States' AND vaccine='Exemption' AND dose='Any Exemption'

assertion: the percentage of kindergartners who received the MMR vaccine inched down to 92.4%, below the 95% rate seen pre-pandemic
Rates for the varicella vaccine fell from 94% to 93.4%; two doses inched up from 92.1% to 92.2%; DTaP fell from 92.1% to 92%; hepatitis B held steady
Idaho had the highest exemption rate at 17.5% followed by Utah, Oregon, Arizona and Nevada.
California, New York and West Virginia each had the lowest exemption rates of 0.1% followed by Connecticut and Maine.
Amid a record-breaking year of measles cases
independent_value: Linked GMA piece says 2026 measles cases set to surpass last year's total
